name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: International PhD students to face strict limits on time in the US
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 23 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02280-3 Trump administration takes action to address ‘forever students’.

changes.title: Iran war and Trump tariffs fuel higher gas prices and renewed inflation risks
changes.summary: The affordability crisis is revving up again. The war in Iran and Trump’s tariffs are pushing prices up and raising fears of renewed inflation.

changes.title: Trump says 'a lot was learned' from White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting
changes.summary: President Donald Trump thanks reporters and recalls the events of the night of the first White House Correspondents' Dinner earlier this year, where a gunman attempted to storm the room at the Washington Hilton.

changes.title: Trump on LeBron James: ‘Maybe He’s a Racist’
changes.summary: President Trump has lashed out over the years at NBA star LeBron James, who has been critical of the president in the past.

changes.title: Trump speaks at White House Correspondents' Dinner, in redo after April attack
changes.summary: President Trump is attending the redo of the White House Correspondents' Dinner on Friday night, after an armed assailant upended April's dinner.

changes.title: Trump calls Obama's speech at past White House Correspondents' Dinner 'respectful'
changes.summary: President Trump recounts a previous White House Correspondents' Dinner during which former President Barack Obama gave a speech. Trump also reflects on his decision to run for office, and his relationship with the press.

changes.title: Special Report: Trump delivers speech at rescheduled White House Correspondents’ Dinner
changes.summary: Watch President Donald Trump’s full speech at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner, which was rescheduled after a shooting at the previous dinner in April. Trump took swipes at some of the journalists in the room and some political rivals while touting his accomplishments.

changes.title: Trump touts his accomplishments and relationship with the press at Correspondents' Dinner
changes.summary: President Trump gave lengthy speech at the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner, where he insulted his political rivals and touted his accomplishments and relationship with the press.

changes.title: Trump returns to correspondents' dinner 3 months after shooting
changes.summary: President Donald Trump returned to the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Association dinner Friday night, delivering a rambling, hour-long speech. (Image credit: Rod Lamkey).

changes.title: At Correspondents’ Dinner, a Rambling Trump Hurls Insults
changes.summary: President Trump gave the keynote speech as relations between his administration and the press continue to deteriorate.
